overview.configCallout.title: Measure your own data models
overview.configCallout.body: This Overview shows the built-in quality checks (assets, equipment, time series, files and more). To also measure links in your project's data models, go to Configuration and upload a YAML or JSON file that lists space:externalId:version models and View.property links.
overview.configCallout.next: Next: open Configuration, upload the file, then choose Run everything.
overview.configCallout.nextNoRun: Next: open Configuration and upload the file, then ask whoever deploys Context Quality to run the backend workflow with it. This dashboard cannot start a run.
configuration.firstRun.title: Add your own data-model links
configuration.firstRun.body: Built-in quality checks are measured on every run and need no file. A configuration file is optional: it lists data models and View.property links for the Custom configured metrics section on Overview.
configuration.firstRun.noResultsYet: No quality run has finished yet, so Overview cannot show scores. Start a run from this page with Run with this file after you add a valid file; the blue banner above the top bar shows progress.
configuration.firstRun.builtInOnlyHint: Your latest run measured the built-in checks. Dimension scores are on Overview; upload a file below and run again to populate Custom configured metrics with your data-model links.
configuration.firstRun.steps.title: How it works
configuration.firstRun.steps.1: Download the example YAML or upload or paste your own file below.
configuration.firstRun.steps.2: Choose a run action (for example Run everything), confirm, and follow the status banner above the top bar.
configuration.firstRun.steps.3: Open Overview: built-in scores appear under Dimension overview; your file's links appear under Custom configured metrics.
configuration.firstRun.noRun: This dashboard cannot start a run, so uploading a file here will not start anything. Ask whoever deploys Context Quality to run the backend workflow with your file. When a run runs elsewhere, the banner above the top bar still shows its status.

run.confirm.note.duration: The run may take a few minutes to over 30 minutes.

run.confirm.note.noCancel: Once started, the run cannot be cancelled from here.
run.confirm.body.everything: This measures every dimension and the metrics of your configuration file, as one new run. When it finishes, every number on the dashboard comes from this run.
run.confirm.body.dimensions: This measures every dimension again, without the metrics of your configuration file. The configured metrics keep the numbers of their last run.
run.confirm.body.configured: This measures only the metrics named in your configuration file. The dimensions keep the numbers of their last run.
run.confirm.body.dimension: This will run the {{name}} quality check again using the latest data. Only the {{name}} results will be updated. All other results and previous run history will be preserved.
run.confirm.body.configuredView: This will run the {{name}} quality checks again using the latest data. Only {{name}} results will be updated. All other checks and previous run history will be preserved.

run.confirm.cost: A run reads the data of every facility space in the project, so it can take from a few minutes to over half an hour and puts load on the project while it runs.
run.confirm.oneAtATime: Only one run can go on at a time, and a run cannot be cancelled from here. Start it only if you mean to.
run.reads.asset-hierarchy: It reads the CogniteAsset instances of the facility spaces.
run.reads.equipment-asset: It reads the CogniteEquipment instances of the facility spaces.
run.reads.time-series: It reads the CogniteTimeSeries instances of the facility spaces and the latest datapoint of each, and the CogniteAsset instances for the monitoring coverage.
run.reads.maintenance: It reads the CogniteMaintenanceOrder and CogniteNotification instances of the facility spaces.
run.reads.file-annotation: It reads the CogniteDiagramAnnotation edges of the facility spaces.
run.reads.model-3d: It reads the Cognite3DObject instances of the facility spaces, and the CogniteAsset instances for the asset coverage.
run.reads.files: It reads the CogniteFile instances of the facility spaces. Files that are not in the core data model are not read.
run.busy.title: A run is already in progress
run.busy.other: A run is already in progress. It may be the scheduled one. Wait until it has finished, then start this run.
run.busy.own: The run you started is still in progress. Wait until it has finished, then start another.
run.busy.hint: A run is in progress (it may be the scheduled one). Wait until it has finished before starting another.
